label: benign
description: Scientific and mathematical text where format characters carry their actual meaning: Greek letters in formulae, mathematical operators, the invisible operators U+2061 and U+2062 exactly as MathML-derived text produces them, superscripts and subscripts, chemical formulae, units, abstracts, and a statistics table. The attack corpus uses these operators as padding; here each one separates a function from its argument or marks a product.

cases.title: Photoelectric effect abstract with Greek letters
cases.text: We measure the stopping potential of sodium as a function of wavelength. Across λ = 365 nm to λ = 546 nm the plot of eV₀ against ν is linear, with slope h and intercept −φ, confirming that the maximum kinetic energy follows K_max = hν − φ.
cases.rationale: A physics abstract whose Greek letters (λ, ν, φ) and minus signs are the standard symbols of the photoelectric equation, all visible and meaning exactly what they say.

cases.title: Quadratic formula from MathML with invisible times
cases.rationale: The U+2062 invisible times characters are what MathML emits between the factors 4, a, c and 2, a; they mark multiplication in the quadratic formula and are invisible only in the way any operator is when the rendering engine draws products without a sign.

cases.title: Function application in a calculus excerpt
cases.text: Let f⁡(x) = x³ − 3x. Then f′⁡(x) = 3x² − 3, and on the unit interval g⁡(x) = f⁡(x)⁢sin⁡(πx) has g′⁡(x) = 0 at each endpoint.
cases.rationale: The U+2061 characters sit exactly where MathML puts them, between a function name and its argument, and the single U+2062 marks the product of f(x) and sin⁡(πx).

cases.title: Statistics table for a drug trial
cases.text:

cases.rationale: A trial results table whose ± signs, Greek χ, and en dash are conventional statistical notation with no hidden characters anywhere.

cases.title: Neutralisation equation with subscripts and equilibrium arrows
cases.rationale: A chemistry exercise whose subscripts, reaction arrow, and equilibrium sign are the visible notation of two textbook equations.

cases.title: Dimensional check in a lab notebook
cases.text: Check: ε₀ = 8.854 × 10⁻¹² F·m⁻¹ and μ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ N·A⁻², so 1/√(ε₀μ₀) = 2.998 × 10⁸ m·s⁻¹, which is c within rounding. Sample stored at 25 µm thickness, 4 °C.
cases.rationale: Lab notes whose micro signs, middots, superscripts, and degree signs are the ordinary units notation of electromagnetism, and whose arithmetic checks the speed of light.

cases.title: Set-theoretic statement in a lecture handout
cases.text: Claim: ∀x ∈ ℝ \ ℚ, ∃ a sequence (qₙ) ⊂ ℚ with qₙ → x. Proof sketch: enumerate ℚ ∩ (x − 1/n, x + 1/n) and pick any element; then |qₙ − x| ≤ 1/n → 0.
cases.rationale: A lecture handout stating the density of the rationals, whose symbols — for all, exists, element of, subset, arrows, and the double-struck letters — are standard visible mathematics.

cases.title: Gaussian integral as MathML-derived linear text
cases.text: ∫₀^∞ exp⁡(−x²)⁢dx = √π / 2 ≈ 0.8862, a result the notes derive by squaring the integral and switching to polar coordinates.
cases.rationale: The invisible operators are exactly where MathML places them: U+2061 between exp and its argument, U+2062 between the integrand and the differential dx, each carrying its mathematical meaning.

cases.title: Schrödinger equation line from a physics problem set
cases.text: Problem 3: verify that ψ(x, t) = A·exp⁡(i(kx − ωt)) satisfies iħ ∂ψ/∂t = −(ħ²/2m) ∂²ψ/∂x² for a free particle of mass m and momentum p = ħk.
cases.rationale: A problem-set line whose reduced Planck constant, partial derivatives, and Greek psi are the visible notation of the Schrödinger equation, with U+2061 only marking the exponential's argument.

cases.title: Bayes' rule stated with MathML products
cases.text: Bayes' rule: P(A|B) = P(B|A)⁢P(A) / P(B), and over a partition {Cₖ} the denominator expands to ∑ₖ P(B|Cₖ)⁢P(Cₖ), so the posterior is well defined whenever every P(B|Cₖ) > 0.
cases.rationale: Each U+2062 marks a genuine product between probability terms, which is precisely the meaning MathML gives the invisible times operator in a derived plain-text rendering of the rule.

cases.title: Astronomy abstract with solar masses and wavelengths
cases.text: We resolve the α Centauri pair at λ = 656.3 nm (Hα) and revise the primary's parameters: T_eff ≈ 5 778 K, M = 1.1 M☉, R = 1.23 R☉, consistent with a G2 V star of solar metallicity.
cases.rationale: An astronomy abstract whose Greek alpha, subscripts, angstrom-free wavelength notation, and solar-mass symbols are the visible conventions of the field.
